# Proten International

> > Africa's leading HR management and consulting firm specializing in talent acquisition, corporate training, and workforce transformation across Nigeria.

Proten International is a comprehensive HR solutions provider based in Lagos, Nigeria, offering recruitment, learning and development, HR outsourcing, and strategic advisory services to organizations across fintech, logistics, and other sectors. The firm combines recruitment expertise with corporate training programs and HR business process outsourcing to help Nigerian companies build and optimize their workforce.

## Key Topics

- Talent Acquisition & Recruitment
- Learning & Development
- HR Outsourcing & BPO
- HR Advisory & Strategy
- Corporate Training
- Leadership Development
- Payroll Management
- Organizational Design
- Professional Skills Development
- Employee Engagement
- Workforce Transformation
- Nigeria HR Services
- Staffing Solutions
- Business Growth
- Critical Thinking & Problem-Solving

- [Top Recruitment Firm in Nigeria](https://protenintl.com/talent-recruitment): Proten's talent recruitment and acquisition services for Nigerian companies.

- [Top HR Outsourcing Company in Nigeria](https://protenintl.com/hr-outsourcing): HR outsourcing, payroll management, and BPO solutions for businesses.
